reviews.review_msg: The most inspiring prof I've ever had. Even for REM 202 W, though it is difficult at times, I was motivated to become a better writer thanks to Scott. I recommend lots of repetition for getting through 202 and talking to Scott about any questions you have!  Very friendly and caring guy.

Amazing prof... for 202W. I learned a lot and will definitely use it going forward. Funny and engaging lectures! Knows his stuff. That being said, I would not try to take him for another course. Very little time given on exams. Figured things out halfway through the course and my grade suffered for it. Need to be very diligent to get an A!
